_note: Hand-curated (loop 39). All BIN mSpellCalculations cross-verified against a live wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vi fetch (2026-07-10). P (Blast Shield) is a pure self-shield (TotalShield = 0.12x max HP via StatByCoefficient mStat=12) with NO damage calc anywhere in its BIN spell or the wiki tooltip -- omitted entirely (no P key, a genuine no-damage passive), not left as an unresolved auto marker. Removed the top-level auto flag: every slot below is hand-verified against both BIN and wiki.
_noteQ: Vault Breaker. TotalDamage = MinDamage[rank] + ADRatio(0.6)*bonusAD (mStat=2, mStatFormula=2) -- matches wiki 'Minimum Physical Damage: 40/60/80/100/120 (+60% bonus AD)' exactly (BIN MinDamage array index1..5 = 40/60/80/100/120). BIN also carries MaxDamageTooltip = TotalDamage x MaxDamageMult(2.5), matching the wiki's full-charge max (100/150/200/250/300, +150% bonus AD) -- NOT curated as a second hit because the combo engine has no charge-level input to distinguish a min-charge vs full-charge Vault Breaker cast; TotalDamage (min/uncharged release) is kept as the single conservative hit, consistent with the pre-existing curation.
_noteW: Denting Blows -- confirmed via wiki as a PASSIVE-slot ability (BIN mSpellTags includes Trait_PassiveSlot, mana=null, no active cast): Vi's basic attacks and Vault Breaker each apply a stack; the 3rd stack consumes all 3 to deal bonus physical on-hit damage = 4/5/6/7/8% (+3.5% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's max HP. BIN TotalDamageTooltip = (MaxHealthDamage[rank] + ADCoefficient*bonusAD) x 0.01 (mDisplayAsPercent=true) -- a %maxHP fraction living only inside the formula tree (no flat DataValues-only entry), so curated via hpPercentCalc per the Skarner P hpPercentCalc precedent, not hpPercentDataValue. Modeled as an onHit bonusEffect (no direct W hits -- W itself is never 'cast'), the same shape Warwick P uses; the real trigger condition (every 3rd stack, not literally every attack) is a documented simplification. Also inflicts 20% armor reduction for 4s on the proc target (BIN DataValue ShredAmount=20) -- tagged ArmorShred at the slot level (metadata only; no live shred value is wired into DefenderStat yet, consistent with SkillDamageDb.cs's documented current scope).
_noteE: Relentless Force (the M0X doc's 'Excessive Force' name is stale -- the live wiki confirms this E ability is actually named 'Relentless Force'). Empowers Vi's next basic attack with bonus physical damage in a cone: wiki 'Physical Damage: 10/30/50/70/90 (+110% AD) (+100% AP)', matching BIN TotalDamageTooltip = BaseDamage[rank] + ADRatio(1.1)*totalAD(mStat=2, no StatFormula) + StatByCoefficient(mCoefficient=1, mStat omitted -> defaults AP) exactly -- confirms the previously-unexplained bare StatByCoefficient third part really is the wiki's '+100% AP' term, not a BIN artifact to discard. Curated as a DIRECT hit on E (not a bonusEffect), following the Vayne Q 'Tumble empowers next auto' precedent already in this file set -- the E node in a combo represents the empowered auto landing.
_noteR: Cease and Desist. Damage = RBaseDamage[rank] + RBonusADRatio(0.9)*bonusAD (mStat=2, mStatFormula=2) -- matches the wiki-documented base damage progression (50/150/250/350 at wiki ranks 1-3; BIN RBaseDamage array has 7 slots consistent with this project's per-rank clamp convention, values agree at ranks 1-3). BIN also defines SecondaryTargetDamage = Damage x SecondaryTargetDamageMultiplier (currently 1.0) for OTHER champions caught in Vi's dash path -- NOT summed into this hit, since it damages a DIFFERENT target, not a second hit on the same target (Vi dunks one primary target; secondary-target damage applies to a separate champion entirely). Tagged BurstCeiling: Cease and Desist is Vi's single highest realistic burst contribution (up to ~650 + 0.9 bonus AD physical burst, plus a hard stun enabling the follow-up combo).
